name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
shortDescription: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra with a 17.49 cm (6.9 inch) 120 Hz QHD+ display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy, 200 MP camera and S Pen support.
description:
The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra has a 17.49 cm (6.9 inch) QHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a refresh rate of up to 120 Hz, and runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy processor with 12 GB RAM and 256 GB or 512 GB storage. It supports the S Pen.

On the back are four cameras: 200 MP, 50 MP, 50 MP and 10 MP, with 3x and 5x optical zoom and digital zoom up to 100x. The front camera is 12 MP, and the phone records video in up to 8K at 30 fps.

It has an Armor Aluminum frame, Corning Gorilla Armor 2 on the front and Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on the back, an IP68 rating, a 5,000 mAh battery (typical), Wi-Fi 7, UWB, NFC and eSIM support. Samsung lists security updates until 28 February 2033. A charger (travel adapter) is not included in the box.
